metadata.description: Turtleman TMNT squad skills — Turtleman, Splinter, Vernon, and the turtles.

plugins.name: turtleman
plugins.description: Turtleman development mode — calm, direct, siege-specialist precision, TMNT squad deployed via Splinter.

plugins.name: splinter
plugins.description: Splinter — master orchestrator, decomposes tasks and dispatches turtles.

plugins.name: vernon
plugins.description: Vernon — Socratic requirement enforcer. Intercepts vague tasks and asks targeted questions until requirements are specific enough to hand to Splinter.

plugins.name: leonardo
plugins.description: Leonardo — disciplined architect and planner of the squad.

plugins.name: donatello
plugins.description: Donatello — technical implementer, tooling and code.

plugins.name: raphael
plugins.description: Raphael — aggressive reviewer, finds the hard problems.

plugins.name: michelangelo
plugins.description: Michelangelo — creative problem solver, lateral thinking.

plugins.name: shredder
plugins.description: Shredder — adversarial gate keeper, stress-tests plans and catches mistakes.
